title: Your heart beats 100,000 times today 🫀 #shorts
description:
Your heart beats about 100,000 times a day — roughly 70 times a minute, nonstop. Over a lifetime that's close to 3 billion beats, and every day it pumps around 7,000 liters of blood.

Math: 70 beats/min × 1,440 min ≈ 100,800 beats/day. 70 mL per beat × 100,800 ≈ 7,000 L/day.
Sources: American Heart Association (resting heart rate 60–100 bpm); Cleveland Clinic (heart pumps ~2,000 gallons ≈ 7,500 L of blood a day).

Inner Numbers — your body, counted. New Short every day.
#body #heart #science #humanbody #facts

scenes.say: Your heart will beat about one hundred thousand times today.
That's seventy beats every minute, without a single break.
In one year, that's more than thirty six million beats.
And in a whole lifetime? Close to three billion.
But look at what happens inside.
Every beat squeezes out about seventy milliliters of blood.
Do the math, and your heart pumps around seven thousand liters a day.
Right now. While you watch this. Follow for more of your body, counted.
